Name: ElucidHaze's Timeless Grandpa - A Portrait Mod
Author: ElucidHaze
Description:
[b][size=5][font=Times New Roman]Description[/font][/size][/b]
[size=4][color=#D4D4D8]I noticed that there isn't much portrait mods for our lovely grandpa. So I decided to make my own! Presenting to you a high definition but still pixel styled grandfather portrait! >u<[/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#D4D4D8]
I was solely inspired to make this portrait because of the [b]"From Grandpa with Love"[/b] mod by CSS. It adds such heartwarming, beautiful cutscenes and letters to the game, but I always found it a bit funny and hard to take completely seriously while looking at Stardew Valley's normal vanilla portrait for Grandpa! This more realistic but pixelized overhaul is designed to match the emotional weight of those scenes and match the game's pixel style. [/color][/size]

[size=4]Please let me know if there's any bugs, or suggestions to improve it more. I'm always open to it! Keep in mind that I'm a total noob when it comes to modding and may be late to reply or not see the comments due to being busy with high school. [/size]

[size=4][i][font=Times New Roman]Note: I don't[/font][/i][i][font=Times New Roman] know if this mod works on mobile devices as I only play and mod on PC, so use it at your own risk if you are playing on mobile[/font][/i][i][font=Times New Roman]! [/font][/i][font=Arial]0...0"'[/font][/size]

[b][size=5][font=Times New Roman]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Download and extract the zip file.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Navigate the file's folders: ElucidHaze's Customized Grandfather Portraits > Portraits[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Choose which of the options you want:Grandpa - Darker Skin or Grandpa Light Skin[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Copy the one you chose (right click and select copy), then paste it directly into your Stardew [i]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits folder[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]In game when the grandpa speaks, press the [b]'P' key[/b] on your keyboard until you see the brand new portrait![/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=5][font=Times New Roman]Main features[/font][/size][/b]
[size=4]This pack contains two distinct skin tone options to better match your aesthetic preferences.[/size]
[size=4]Offers an anime semi-realistic take on Grandfather's portrait.[/size]

[b][size=5][font=Times New Roman]Requirements[/font][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]SMAPI[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Portraiture mod by Platonymous [/b][/size][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Works beautifully alongside CSS' From Grandpa with Love - An Event Mod[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=5][font=Times New Roman]Shout outs[/font][/size][/b]
